rules.reason: README 45-50 documents reusable shared source and one subscription per selected/retried attempt; 7 and 18-34 distinguish visit identity even for the same file. No new global ownership rule.

Task restoration plus documented synchronous startup emission requires receiver eligibility by emission time. The rule states an event relationship rather than a specific API/patch; later streaming remains required. F-progress is treated as the bad current ordering, not preservation policy.

README 52-62 explicitly retains exactly-once audit of already accepted decode work after departure, stops new retired admission and visible progress. The body neither drops pending audit on cleanup nor grants retired callbacks fresh admission.

README 11-34 preserves entry-bound accepted retries and newer-visit resource/view ownership under synchronous cancellation reentry. Existing semantics remain unchanged; no migration of shared source ownership, no blanket cancellation or suppression of accepted retained commands.

The three actual failed checks per baseline show a retired attempt receiving a later frame in startup-reopen/hide/switch traces, while initial delivery has improved. The verification asks for documented outcomes in separate phases, not a unique implementation; explanation explicitly leaves isolated causality unverified.

Task and README 36-41 exclude record-format extension and preserve public interfaces. Shared source reuse and independent-workspace cancellation boundaries are visible requirements, not inferred from assertion labels.

applicability.reason: R-source-timing states the same source/file can serve multiple visits, distinct from each attempt subscription lifetime.
R-source-timing states each selected or retried attempt starts its own subscription to the shared source.
F-cancel constructs one native controller and cleanup handle per transfer attempt.
F-view-owner captures the admitted file/attempt tuple; R-history-view retains accepted event attribution after current visit changes. This does not demand copying arbitrary mutable objects.
R-history-view explicitly permits visible callback to synchronously select/hide.
R-history-view and F-view-owner separate retained audit from current-visit visible updates.

unresolved.reason: The unisolated causal contribution and incomplete baseline repair are scope/validation limits; the rules do not pretend they are proven causes or prerequisites already fulfilled.
